_README: Copy this file to config.json and edit values for your machine. config.json is gitignored. Every key is OPTIONAL: anything you omit is auto-detected or falls back to a sensible default relative to the repo root. Precedence is environment variable > config.json > auto-detection > default. Windows paths need doubled backslashes in JSON (C:\\Users\\you\\...) or use forward slashes. error_webhook_url is disabled (crash reports never leave the machine) unless you set it; it is not a working default here on purpose, since it sends crash info off-machine to whatever URL you put there.
